genxml.title: Dallas DS1742W nonvolatile timekeeping RAM (Fuel L1 storage part, 3.3 V, 2 KiB)
genxml.doc: The 2,048-byte battery-backed SRAM and clock part identified on a revision B Fuel board. The register contract here covers what the sources state: the clock bytes at the top of the address range and the remaining bytes as RAM. Grades say how each item was derived: established means the manufacturer specification as the source records it, inferred means a public driver, a board marking or arithmetic on an established fact. The clock byte meanings are in Table 2 of the datasheet (see the device README); the reset state and the RAM layout are not stated by the sources and are not listed.

struct.name: RAM
struct.doc: Battery-backed RAM below the clock bytes. The sources give no RAM count and no layout inside it. The 2,040 is inferred from the clock placement, not stated by a source.

struct.name: CLOCK
struct.from: Maxim DS1742 Y2KC datasheet 19-6715 Rev 6/13, Table 2 register map, p. 5 (clock at 0x7f8 to 0x7ff)
struct.doc: The eight clock and calendar bytes at the top of the chip. Table 2 (p. 5) gives their order and bit meanings, which the device README transcribes; this entry names each byte by offset only.
